RF-Scope APK build information
==============================

App name: RF-Scope
Package: com.rfscope.app
Version: 0.7.0 (versionCode 7)
Build type: debug (installable; Android Debug certificate)
Min SDK: 29 (Android 10)
Target/compile SDK: 34 (Android 14)
Built at: 2026-11-08 (Asia/Shanghai)
APK SHA-256: a4f3d3438457e9eba0a379f72719b4ae5ab337d296f8b3a8f93bc83fb6d1ae40
Size: 24814762 bytes

Changes in 0.7.0:
- Live TinySA scan loop with single scan and LIVE/STOP.
- Fixed-row, timestamped 240-frame waterfall without vertical compression.
- Manual start/stop/points frequency controls.
- More presets including carrier 4G/5G band chooser.
- RBW choices and VBW/AVG smoothing options.
- TONE modes PEAK / AVERAGE / MARKER and adjustable TONE reference level.
- Four markers M1-M4 with frequency entry and graph labels.
- Stop LIVE automatically stops TONE.
- SignalStrength event callback sampling and 120-second trend window.
- Three-bar icons in RSRP/RSRQ/SINR cards and trend rows.
- WiFi parabolic channel charts with SSID labels, selection highlighting, 5GHz empty-channel compression.

Notes:
- Debug certificate; not suitable for Play Store publishing.
- Hardware behavior depends on TinySA firmware and OEM USB implementation.
